pipeline.notes: Funding runs from October 2027. Two questions still open: whether a Dr. sc. hum. from a medical faculty falls under DAAD's separate human-medicine regulations, and whether Hanoi or DAAD Thailand owns the file given Myanmar nationality with residence in Bangkok.

pipeline.name: Heidelberg Institute of Global Health, central doctoral route
pipeline.next_action: Denkinger enquiry went out 31 August 2026. The Mueller, Deckert and Dureab drafts are written and unsent; send them rather than waiting on one reply.
pipeline.notes: No deadline, reviewed quarterly. Three PDFs under 5MB total: cover letter 1 to 2 pages stating personal details, motivation, topics, preferred supervisor, previous contact and funding status; CV with grades, teaching, publications with hyperlinks and referee contacts; proposal of 1 to 2 pages. Pairs with the DAAD deadline above, which is where the money is.

pipeline.name: PhD scholarship, maternal RSV vaccination and child respiratory health
pipeline.next_action: CV and transcripts by email to Dr Fekede Kumsa (f.kumsa@unsw.edu.au). Ask in the same message whether a tuition fee scholarship exists for international applicants alongside the AUD 40,000 stipend.
pipeline.notes: Analysis of large linked routinely collected health datasets. Two gaps to name rather than hide: no experience with linked administrative data at population scale, and Stata rather than R.
